anytime.text:
Up before mom's safai alarm?
Smart. Hide in here.

Morning, {name}.
The kaju katli won't eat itself.

Breakfast: three ladoos.
Nutritionist: on Diwali leave.

Dhanteras shopping energy,
but make it a playlist.

Lunch at a relative's?
Earphones in, fake smile on.

Mithai coma loading...
Press play to fight it.

Fairy lights still tangled?
Same. Play something.

Golden hour, diya hour,
main character hour.

Diyas lit, kurta on.
Now the soundtrack.

Crackers started outside.
The real bass starts in here.

Card night's on.
Your playlist has the best hand.

Dinner done, dessert round four.
Play something sweeter.

Neighbours still on rockets?
Drown them out, politely.

Late night, last anar.
One more song. Fine, two.

Midnight, and the rockets
haven't heard of sleep either.

Late-night fridge raid for ladoos?
That needs a soundtrack.

Itni subah uth gaye?
Safai duty se pehle ek gaana.

Good morning ji!
Aaj ka menu: ladoo aur bass.

Nashte mein mithai?
Diwali hai, sab maaf hai.

Mummy: 'Jaale saaf kar.'
Tum: volume up kar.

Lunch heavy tha?
Toh playlist bhi heavy chahiye.

Kaju katli ke baad neend?
Ye gaana jagayega.

Lights ki wiring suljhao,
gaana hum chalate hain.

Diye jalane ka time.
Vibe jalane ka bhi.

Naye kapde, nayi selfie.
Ab naya gaana bhi.

Bahar pataakhe,
andar asli dhamaka.

Teen patti shuru?
Bluff kam, bass zyada.

Dinner ke baad mithai,
mithai ke baad gaane.

Padosi abhi bhi rockets pe?
Hum bass pe.

Last anaar, last gaana.
Pakka. Shayad.

12 baj gaye, pataakhe nahi ruke.
Tum bhi mat ruko.

Raat ko fridge se ladoo chori?
Chori mein bhi music chahiye.

Soan papdi box spotted.
It's been regifted since 2019.

A relative just asked your marks.
That's your cue for headphones.

Found Rs 50 in old jeans.
Diwali cleaning finally paid.

Your diet applied for Diwali leave.
Request approved.

Rangoli took three hours.
The dog took three seconds.

One bulb dies, the whole string dies.
Fairy lights are dramatic.

Just looking like a wow:
you, in the new kurta.

Moye moye is when the anar
turns out to be a dud.

Family group: 47 diya GIFs.
You: one great song.

AQI is 400.
Your taste is 1000.

Gift idea: dry fruits.
Gift reality: dry fruits, again.

Sharma ji's son lit 51 diyas.
You lit the vibe. Tie.

Who lit the anar upside down?
Binod.

Crush viewed your rangoli story?
Play something romantic.

Kids get phuljhadis.
You get the aux. Same power.

Mom: 'Hand out these sweets.'
Also mom: 'Not those ones.'

Dhanteras: everyone bought gold.
You bought nothing. Free vibes.

The pressure cooker whistled
louder than the crackers.

New outfit: on.
Price tag: also on. Check.

Dad guarding the sutli bomb
like he's on bomb squad duty.

Be the diya, not the dud.
Press play.

Cracker-free zone: your ears.
Bass-only zone, actually.

Soan papdi ka dabba
ghoom ke wapas aa gaya.

Chachi: 'Beta, aage kya plan hai?'
Plan: ye playlist.

Marks pooche koi?
Earphones lagao, instant mute.

Safai mein mila purana charger.
Aur 2019 ka trauma.

Moye moye ho gaya,
anaar phata hi nahi.

Rasode mein kaun tha?
Ladoo gayab hain.

Itna sannata kyun hai bhai?
Play dabao.

Pushpa jhukega nahi,
par mithai ke aage jhuk gaya.

Sharma ji ke bete ne 101 diye jalaye.
Tumne vibe jalayi.

So beautiful, so elegant,
just looking like a rangoli.

Mummy ki rangoli pe pair pad gaya?
Bhaago, gaana baad mein.

Diwali bonus nahi mila?
Bass bonus le lo.

Last kaju katli koi nahi uthata.
Tum utha lo. Legend.

Gift mein phir dry fruits?
Koi na, gaane toh fresh hain.

Padosi ki lights zyada bright?
Tumhari playlist zyada lit.

Phuljhadi chhoti, attitude bada.
Bilkul tumhari tarah.

Uncle ka 'Happy Diwali' GIF
phir se aaya. Volume badhao.

Bahut hard, bahut hard:
tumhara Diwali outfit.

Paisa hi paisa hoga?
Pehle gaana hi gaana.

Dhanteras: sab sona khareed rahe.
Tum bas so rahe.

Ek aur ladoo?
Control, Uday, control.

Kitne diye the?
51, Sardar. Ab gaana chalao.
